steps.name: Open builder
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Build Itinerary** / **Edit Itinerary**.

steps.name: Visit date with offerings
steps.do: On **Set Visit Date**, pick a today-or-future date that offers Meet the Guardians talks and Wild Encounters, then continue through the wizard.
steps.expect: Meet the Guardians and Wild Encounters steps list at least one option each.

steps.name: Add talk
steps.do: On the Meet the Guardians step, add a listed talk (e.g. **African Penguin** if offered).

steps.name: Add wild encounter
steps.do: On **Wild Encounters**, add a listed encounter (e.g. **Kangaroo** if offered).

steps.name: Talk already on planner
steps.expect: The talk already has a timeline pill at its offered time (fixed-time items are auto-scheduled; do not use **Schedule an item** for them).

steps.name: Encounter already on planner
steps.do: Find the wild encounter on Day Planner.
steps.expect: The encounter already has a timeline pill at its offered time.

steps.name: List matches planner
steps.do: Switch to **List View**, then back to **Day Planner View**.
steps.expect: Talk and encounter appear on the list and stay scheduled on the planner.
